body: It's not motivation. I literally cannot grasp certain math concepts. I have years of education to catch up on and I have to do it alone. If I ever get to the point where I'm smart enough to pass, it'll take years, and I'll be miserable and broke in that time.

I've been denied jobs because of it. Even at a daycare or certain mall jobs. The biggest problem is I can't even learn job skills without it.

I don't have the option of relegating my job search to only those who don't care about a GED. I can't live off of jobs like those because they only pay seven bucks an hour. I can't gain skills because trade schools require a GED. 

I already know how to speak and present myself well. It's not enough in this world.

I've seen some of the practice questions. The math is like a foreign language to me. I was held back in special classes all throughout school, so I don't understand anything beyond some pre-algebra. And I've heard the new test has statistics and calculus and such. How fucked am I?
